checks: “Yes” and proposing 4:30 communicate agreement; paper and punctuation do not address finish-of-shift review. 這個班別結束前／四點半. English options, zh-TW and each rationale checked; offline ASR and editorial review, not runtime acceptance.

activeQuestion.prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 聆聽問題或陳述，選出最合適的回應。

options.text: The chart is made of paper.
options.whyZh: 材質無法回應是否能在下班前檢視。

options.text: Yes, let us meet at four thirty.
options.whyZh: 同意檢視並提出碰面時間，符合請求。

options.text: I ended it with a period.
options.whyZh: 把 ends 當成句子結尾，與班別結束無關。
